verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AI capabilities only through external agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) connecting to SigNoz via its MCP server and Agent Skills. That is a developer integration path, not AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced inside the SigNoz product itself. No in-product AI assistant, insight panel, or suggestion feature is documented, so this is adjacent support and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Connect Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and other AI agents to SigNoz via MCP for natural language access to metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.
Use natural language to query metrics, traces, and logs; investigate alerts; and manage dashboards, alert rules, saved views, and notification channels.
